'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I have a delicate matter for you. There is quite a commotion around the laboratories at the moment. My people continue to investigate these areas and recover anything that may be useful for civilians and others who need it. On top of that, these scum keep attacking groups associated with me. Almost as if they're doing it deliberately. I want you to teach them a lesson. Perhaps these misguided individuals can still find their way back to the right path. However, there is one condition: you must wear a chemical respirator or gas mask while doing so. They need to understand exactly who is eliminated their people, so make sure you deal with them at close range.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 40 any target from less than 60 meters away while wearing a gas mask or respirator on [[The Lab]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +2 [[Vitality|Vitality skill]] levels
* +4 [[Immunity|Immunity skill]] levels
* [[Therapist]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks craft for [[M.U.L.E. stimulant injector]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 2]]
{{quote|Thank you for your work, and don't concern yourself. Some people only understand when they're approached from a position of strength.}}
